SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') AS ym, s.store_id<900 AS physical, f.channel_code,
 count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS d_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS d_keys,
 sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - round(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS g999,
 min(f.vat_rate) AS minvat, max(f.vat_rate) AS maxvat
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount, f.vat_rate, f.quantity, f.etl_loaded_at, s.store_id, p.category, p.vat_class
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999)
SELECT strftime(sale_date,'%Y-%m') ym, category='ZZ Test' AS test, vat_class, vat_rate, count(*) n, sum(gross_amount) g, sum(net_amount) nt,
  sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 OR net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, count(DISTINCT sale_date) days, min(etl_loaded_at) e0, max(etl_loaded_at) e1
FROM l GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1,2),

FROM c LEFT JOIN a ON a.sale_date=c.business_date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH a AS (SELECT strftime(sale_date,'%Y-%m') ym, f.sale_date, sum(f.net_amount) n FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1,2),
c AS (SELECT strftime(business_date,'%Y-%m') ym, business_date, sum(net_sales_before_returns) c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id<900 AND store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT c.ym, sum(a.n) fact_net, sum(c.c) ctrl_net, count(*) ndays, sum(CASE WHEN a.sale_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) days_missing_fact, sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(a.n,0)-c.c)>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) diffdays
FROM c LEFT JOIN a ON a.sale_date=c.business_date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected'))
SELECT strftime(w.dd,'%Y-%m') ym, sum(f.gross_amount) web_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND w.dd BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT strftime(f.sale_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS store_sales_incl_vat_before_returns
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
